You can see an opened fridge. What a letdown! The fridge is empty! You see an oven. You can make out a table. The table is massive. On the table you can make out a cookbook. If you haven't noticed it already, there seems to be something there by the wall, it's a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you make out a red apple. Look over there! a stove. The stove is conventional. But the thing hasn't got anything on it.

There is an open sliding patio door leading east. There is a closed frosted-glass door leading west. There is an exit to the south.

There is a knife and a fried carrot on the floor.
